candidates.title: Interactive Desktop Pet Interaction Playground
candidates.change: Redesign the home intro screen into an interactive desktop playground where users test controlling, dragging, and speaking to their new pet before finishing setup.
candidates.why: Support emails report users being confused about how to control, hide, or interact with the pet after onboarding, and the finish step has a low 68.9% conversion with high drop-off.

home_intro.headline: Try Out Your Companion Desktop Controls
home_intro.body: Practice calling, moving, and chatting with your pet right here on your desktop screen.

guard.reason: Home intro redesign remains within onboarding limits and preserves screen functionality.

candidates.score_note: Addresses the highest funnel drop-off step (31.1%) and strong support feedback, but requires heavy custom design.

candidates.title: Companion Personality Archetype Selection Screen
candidates.change: Introduce a dedicated archetype selection screen before path choice that matches pet traits to desktop companion styles.
candidates.why: The mean time for choose_path is 514s, indicating users hesitate when deciding how to configure their companion.

new_archetype_selector.headline: Choose Your Companion Vibe
new_archetype_selector.body: Select a personality archetype to tailor your desktop companion experience.

guard.reason: Adding a new archetype selector screen within onboarding without removing required steps is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Adds an additional screen to an already low drop-off step (13.8%) without support email evidence.

candidates.title: Pre-Finish Cloud Sync Account Link Step
candidates.change: Move sign_in to occur right before the home_intro finish stage to guarantee pet cloud saving immediately prior to desktop launch.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again, and moving account sync right before launch ensures state is preserved.

sign_in.headline: Save Your Companion to the Cloud
sign_in.body: Link your account now to ensure your pet is backed up and never lost across sessions.

guard.reason: Reordering sign_in to occur later in onboarding is explicitly permitted by Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Strong support evidence (8 emails) regarding reset state; reordering step is low-to-medium effort.

candidates.title: Interactive Adoption Certificate Signature Experience
candidates.change: Create an interactive adoption flow with real-time certificate signing and pet naming step before proceeding to setup.
candidates.why: Adoption completion rate drops to 71.1% with a high mean time of 1017s; introducing an engaging certificate signing flow builds ownership.

adoption_certificate.headline: Sign Your Official Desktop Companion Certificate
adoption_certificate.body: Give your companion a name and sign the adoption agreement to lock in your cloud backup.

guard.reason: The adoption certificate redesign removes the official stamp required by Rule 2.

candidates.title: Desktop Overlay Troubleshooting and Rendering Guidance
candidates.change: Display explicit guidance on the waiting screen explaining how the desktop companion overlay integrates with Windows and Mac display permissions.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets report pet not showing on desktop or app failing to open, while the home step waiting time has a high mean duration of 2336s.

waiting.headline: Preparing Desktop Overlay & Display Permissions
waiting.body: If your desktop companion does not automatically appear on top of other windows, check your system permission settings.
waiting.hint: Desktop overlay relies on system screen draw permissions.

guard.reason: The waiting screen copy is replaced with system overlay instructions, losing the required job of showing that the pet is being made.

candidates.title: Quick-Access Desktop Tray & Hotkey Notification
candidates.change: Add a notification badge and key binding guide on the final screen showing how to toggle desktop pet visibility instantly.
candidates.why: 3 users emailed about being unable to hide or control their pet post-onboarding, leading to drop-offs on the finish step.

home_intro.hint: Press Alt+P (or Cmd+P) anytime to summon or hide your desktop pet.

guard.reason: Adding tray hotkey guidance to home intro stays within onboarding and complies with all rules.

candidates.score_note: Directly targets high finish step drop-off with simple notification and guide config tweaks.

candidates.title: Starter Accessory Unlock Badge Banner
candidates.change: Add a bonus starter accessory badge incentive to path selection to encourage completing the initial choice promptly.
candidates.why: Path selection has a huge mean time of 514s; providing an early incentive motivates faster decision-making.

choose_path.headline: Select a Path & Unlock Exclusive Starter Accessories
choose_path.body: Pick your setup style now to claim a free accessory item for your desktop pet.

guard.reason: Onboarding copy mentions 'free accessory' items and gifts, violating Rule 3.

candidates.title: Split-View Companion Preview & Photo Customization Layout
candidates.change: Reframe the upload_photos screen with a split layout comparing standard presets directly alongside custom upload previews.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported custom pets looking wrong or failing, causing high friction and long adoption step durations.

upload_photos.headline: Custom Photo Upload & Preset Comparison
upload_photos.body: Preview how your custom photo renders on your 3D pet alongside standard models.

guard.reason: Asks for personal information (custom photo upload)

candidates.title: Account Persistence & Multi-Device Sync Explanation
candidates.change: Update sign-in microcopy to clarify how account credentials prevent pet loss when upgrading or switching desktop computers.
candidates.why: 8 support emails were received regarding missing or reset pets after signing back in, which is the single largest support category.

sign_in.headline: Secure Your Pet & Enable Cross-Device Sync
sign_in.body: Signing in links your pet personality and unlocks to your email so your pet is never lost during updates.
sign_in.hint: Your pet progress saves to cloud automatically upon sign in.

guard.reason: text in 'sign_in.body' asks for or mentions personal data

candidates.title: Full-Bleed Visual Onboarding Welcome & Companion Preview
candidates.change: Redesign the initial welcome story screen into a full-bleed interactive visual introduction showcasing animated desktop pets in action.
candidates.why: The first step takes a long mean time (514s), requiring a more engaging visual hook to pull users into onboarding immediately.

story.headline: Welcome to Your Interactive Desktop Companion
story.body: Watch your pet roam, play, and assist on your desktop.

guard.reason: Redesigning the story screen into a visual preview preserves pet introduction and complies with all rules.

candidates.score_note: Redesign addresses choose_path hesitation time, but drop-off is relatively low and effort is high.
